Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207, the CIF term already covers loading costs, so the added charge is a material alteration that does not become part of the contract.

Q8260.reason: Water is produced directly by the oxygen-dependent final step of the electron transport chain, so it stops first without oxygen.

Q5585.reason: A lay witness may give an opinion on speed if shown to be an experienced driver able to estimate vehicle speeds.
